name: Comprehensive Educational Loan Scheme - Sikkim
benefit:
- The maximum loan amount is ₹5,00,000/- for full-time professional courses within Sikkim - The loan amount of ₹7,50,000/- for studies in India, and ₹15,00,000/- for studies abroad.
**Note:** In case of discontinuity of studies or the loanee dies, the co-applicant shall be liable to refund the entire amount of the loan within a period not exceeding one year.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant's family annual income should not exceed ₹2,50,000/- for studies within India and ₹5,00,000/- for studies abroad. 1. The institution where the applicant wants to study, whether in India or abroad, must be recognized by the relevant authority in India. 1. Only one member per family shall be considered for the benefit, except in the case of Below Poverty Line (BPL) families. 1. Only members of Below Poverty Line (BPL) families will be considered for the study in Sikkim.
Note: Children of Government/Public Sector Undertaking employees are also eligible.
